answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 147155 Country: India Title: I am going to have a baby in December if Allah wishes. If it is a boy I am thinking of keeping his name ‘Umar Bin Sajjad’ and if it is a girl then I will be keeping it as ‘Aisha Bint Sajjad’. What is your saying? Question: I am going to have a baby in December if Allah wishes. If it is a boy I am thinking of keeping his name ‘Umar Bin Sajjad’ and if it is a girl then I will be keeping it as ‘Aisha Bint Sajjad’. What is your saying? Answer ID: 147155 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 286/220/D=3/1438) You have chosen very suitable names. Ma-shaAllah, both the names are good, you can keep any of them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
